svg.title: LyricGlass Spark
svg.desc: Karaoke bouncer for LyricGlass. Recolor by setting the CSS color property or, when inlined, --lg-bouncer on a parent (the host should also set color: var(--lg-bouncer)). Body uses currentColor; highlights are a white sheen and a dark overlay so any user colour still reads. When used as an image, the color="#FF3F4C" presentation attribute is the default.
